name: pullup-pro
description: PULLUP PRO 2.0 — ISA Personal fitness ecosystem: web app, PWA, Telegram Mini App, sync API and Telegram bot

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pullup/web && npm run build -w @pullup/api && npm run build -w @pullup/telegram-bot
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/db && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/telegram-bot && tsc -p tests
scripts.pretest:e2e: npm run build:web && npm run build -w @pullup/api
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
